arguments.task_description: Implement Taskboard API task attachments and project webhooks: multipart upload of any file type up to 10 MB per file to a task, stored through an AttachmentStorage interface (local filesystem volume in dev, Amazon S3 in AWS) under server-generated keys, listed and downloaded with the original filename; and an outbound webhook notifier that, when a task changes status, POSTs a JSON event to the project's user-configured webhook URL asynchronously from a background thread pool with a short retry.
